minutes.title: Welcome and Adoption of Terms of Reference
minutes.text: The Chair opened the inaugural meeting of the Model Risk Committee and welcomed attendees. The Terms of Reference document was presented and formally adopted without amendment. The ToR establishes the MRC as the principal governance body for model risk oversight, meeting quarterly with authority to approve or reject models for production.

minutes.title: Model Inventory Overview
minutes.text:
DKK presented the model inventory comprising 8 models across 6 categories (Hazard, Pricing, Loss, Spatial, Valuation, Risk). The tiering methodology follows the Handbook Chapter 8 Materiality × Complexity matrix:

- Tier 1 (Maximum): GEV Hazard Curve (MKM-GH-001), PRS Pricing (MKM-PR-001)
- Tier 2 (Substantial): Storm Intensity (MKM-SI-001), Storm-Gauge Response (MKM-SG-001), Depth-Damage (MKM-DD-001)
- Tier 3 (Moderate): Property Valuation (MKM-PV-001), Mortgage Pricer (MKM-MP-001), Risk Assessor (MKM-RA-001)

All models are currently in Development lifecycle stage with David K Kelly as model owner.

minutes.title: Model Chain and Data Handoffs
minutes.text:
The end-to-end model chain was reviewed, from Storm Intensity → Storm-Gauge → GEV Hazard → PRS Pricing, with parallel paths through Depth-Damage → Property Valuation → Mortgage Pricer → Risk Assessor. Data handoff field specifications were presented showing the specific fields, types, and descriptions that connect each model pair.

The committee noted the importance of maintaining field-level documentation for audit purposes.

minutes.title: Validation Status and Test Results
minutes.text:
Automated test coverage was presented: 464 Python tests (6 skipped) and 51 JavaScript tests, all passing. Per-model test results PDFs are generated and accessible via the governance dashboard. All models currently have 'Initial' validation status pending independent validation.

Action: Independent validation to be commissioned for Tier 1 models as priority.

minutes.title: Parameter Inventory Review
minutes.text:
The parameter inventory document was presented, cataloguing ~150+ hard-coded parameters across all model modules. Parameters are grouped by model with source file and line number references. The committee agreed this provides a solid baseline for parameter governance.

Action: Establish a parameter change control process requiring MRC approval for Tier 1 model parameters.

minutes.title: RAG Rating Assignment
minutes.text:
Initial RAG ratings were assigned based on documentation completeness, validation status, and maturity:

- Amber: All models currently rated Amber, reflecting Development lifecycle stage and pending independent validation.

The committee agreed that models may progress to Green upon completion of independent validation and production sign-off.

minutes.title: Remediation Actions and Next Steps
minutes.text:
The following remediation priorities were agreed:

1. Commission independent validation for Tier 1 models (GEV Hazard, PRS Pricing) — Target: Q2 2026
2. Assign peer reviewers for all models — Target: March 2026
3. Establish parameter change control process — Target: March 2026
4. Complete sensitivity analysis documentation — Target: Q2 2026
5. Schedule recertification dates for all models

Next MRC Meeting: May 2026 (Quarterly cycle)

minutes.title: AOB
minutes.text: No other business raised. The Chair thanked attendees and closed the meeting at 11:30.
